sleep.title: Pullman Nanjing Lukou Airport
sleep.text: Pullman Nanjing Lukou Airport is in the airport building and connects Terminals 1 and 2, each about a 2-minute walk away. The hotel has a heated pool under a glass roof, a fitness centre, restaurants and flight information displays in the rooms. Check-in starts at 14:00 and check-out is by 12:00.
